steps.title: Create Slack App
steps.detail: Navigate to the developer portal, click 'Create New App', and define your app name and workspace.
steps.whyHuman: Requires login to the Slack developer dashboard.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Settings
steps.detail: Under 'OAuth & Permissions', add Redirect URLs and choose Bot or User token scopes.
steps.whyHuman: Requires business-logic decision on app permissions.

steps.title: Implement OAuth Flow
steps.detail: Redirect users to the Slack authorization URL with your client_id and scopes.
steps.whyHuman: Requires development work to handle the server-side OAuth callback.

config.redirectUriNotes: Must use HTTPS; must match exactly between the dashboard setting and the URL passed in the request.

review.requiredWhen: Required for public distribution (apps used by more than one workspace).
process: Submit for app verification via the dashboard

gotchas.text: Scopes are additive; you cannot remove scopes from an existing token without revoking and re-authorizing.
